title: Slipping past the honour guard in The Old Crypts reported a full success ('GRACE ... success. ... You wait for its swing and go under it. The passage north is yours.') but then a separate line still fired 'The honour guard attacks — your armor takes 2 of it. (hp-1)', contradicting the successful-evasion text. Every other 'slip past' check in the game (wight in Barrow Crypt, Watch-shade in Ashwyn's Watch, bone-eel in the Weeping Caves) cost nothing on success, matching their 'fail costs Nhp' framing.
where: The Old Crypts (under Marrowgate palace) / slip past the honour guard
